rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 65 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6657, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE COMPREHENSIVE AGRARIAN REFORM LAW, IMPOSING A TAX ON THE CONVERSION OF AGRICULTURAL LANDS INTO INDUSTRIAL, COMMERCIAL OR OTHER NON-AGRICULTURA L USES
rows.abstract: Imposes a fifteen percent (15%) tax on all conversions of agricultural land into nonagricultural use, based on its market value, to be accrued to the Agrarian Reform Fund for use of the Comprehensive Agrarian Reform Program.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING QUALIFIED AGRARIAN REFORM BENEFICIARIES A HOMELOT AND OPTIONAL DISTURBANCE COMPENSATION, PERMANENT EMPLOYMENT OF FAMILY MEMBERS, ADVANCE MONETARY CONSIDERATIONS, AND OWNERSHIP OF PREFERRED SHARES OF STOCKS, TO LANDOWNERS, IN CASES OF RECLASSIFICATIO N OF AGRICULTURAL LANDS INTO NON-AGRICULTURA L USES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Converted Agrarian Land Beneficiaries Security Act of 1998". Aims to make legal conversions beneficial to both the landowner and the farmer beneficiary.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRARIAN REFORM since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 12 AND 65 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6657, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE COMPREHENSIVE AGRARIAN REFORM LAW OF 1988, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Entitles the tenant-lessees whose crops are damaged by typhoons, floods and other fortuitous events, to a REDUCTION OF RENTALS proportionate to the extent of damages on the produce where more than fifty percent  (50%) of the crops had been destroyed.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRARIAN REFORM since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING AMPLE OPPORTUNITY TO ALLOW LANDOWNERS AND TENANTS TO ENTER INTO VOLUNTARY LAND TRANSFER AND/OR DIRECT PAYMENT SCHEMES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SIXTY-SIX HUNDRED AND FIFTY SEVEN, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE COMPREHENSIVE AGRARIAN REFORM LAW OF NINETEEN HUNDRED AND EIGHTY-EIGHT
rows.abstract: Provides ample opportunity for both landowners and tenants to enter into voluntary land transfer or a direct payment scheme.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10721

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 6 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6395, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE REVISED CHARTER OF THE NATIONAL POWER CORPORATION
rows.abstract: Entitles the national association of rural electric cooperatives a seat in the National Power Corporation (NAPOCOR) Board , thus providing them the opportunity to be directly heard and to actively participate in the formulation, deliberation and implementation of policies and decision-making process in the NAPOCOR.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT ENTERPRISES AND PRIVATIZATION since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE ESTABLISHMENT AND OPERATIONS OF WOOD PROCESSING PLANTS AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF
rows.abstract: "Wood Processing Plant Act of 1998".  Aims to prevent the establishment and operations of wood processing plants from being used as outlets of illegally-cut timber.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROVIDE INCENTIVES TO ORGANIZED CITIZENS' ENVIRONMENT PROTECTION GROUPS, ESTABLISHING AN ENVIRONMENT DEFENSE FUND FOR THE PURPOSE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Encourages the formation of associations or organizations to assist the government in preserving and protecting a healthy environment and instilling environmental consciousness in the citizens.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on  since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE INCREASE IN THE AUTHORIZED CAPITAL STOCK OF THE NATIONAL ELECTRIFICATION ADMINISTRATION AND ORDAINING THE ENERGIZATION OF ALL BARANGAYS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED TWO HUNDRED AND SIXTY NINE, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'NATIONAL ELECTRIFICATION ADMINISTRATION DECREE'
rows.abstract: Increases the National Electrification Administration (NEA) capitalization from [P5 Billion} to P25 Billion to complement its own initiatives in the pursuit of total rural electrification .
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ENERGY since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CERTAIN SECTIONS OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 269, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE CHARTER OF THE NATIONAL ELECTRIFICATION ADMINISTRATION DECREE
rows.abstract: Increases the membership of the Board of Administrators of the National Electrification Administration (NEA) from four (4) to six (6), ONE OF WHOM SHALL BE A REPRESENTATIVE CHOSEN BY THE NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF ELECTRIC COOPERATIVES.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ENERGY since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REGULATE THE IMPORTATION OF SUBSTANCES THAT DEPLETE THE OZONE LAYER, PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Ozone Layer Protection Law of 1998". Provides for local mechanisms to regulate and monitor the importation of chloroflourocar bon (CFC) and other ozone-depleting substances (ODS) to help prevent the further depletion of the ozone layer the protective gaseous shield of the atmosphere.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECOLOGY since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE GLOBAL WARMING AND CLIMATE CHANGE COUNCIL, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Mandates the proposed Council to monitor global warning and climate changes and undertake studies on its implications, specifically on food production and other related areas of public concern.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE USE OF WATER EFFICIENT LAVATORIES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to mandate and encourage the use of water efficient toilets and latrines which uses one and six-tenth (1.6) gallons of water or less per flushing.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECOLOGY since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING LOCAL GOVERNMENTS TO PLANT TREES ALONG NATIONAL AND LOCAL HIGHWAYS WITHIN ITS TERRITORIAL BOUNDARIES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "The Greening of Philippine Highways Act of 1998". Directs all local government units, in coordination with Department of Interior and Local Government , Department of Environment and Natural Resources, Department of Public Works and Highways and other government agencies, to plant and maintain indigenous Philippine trees along the national and local highways within their respective territorial boundaries.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROMOTE OWNER-CULTIVATO RSHIP OF ECONOMIC-SIZE FARMS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Allows the small landowners to possess and exercise rights of ownership, including the right to cultivate and till their lands , not more than five (5) wide, hectares, as the basis of Philippine agriculture.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRARIAN REFORM since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE IMPOSITION OF THE DEATH PENALTY ON CHILD PROSTITUTION, SEXUAL ABUSE OF CHILDREN AND CHILD TRAFFICKING, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7610, AS AMENDED, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Provides specific penalties for the offenses of child prostitution and other sexual abuse, attempt to commit child prostitution, child trafficking, and attempt to commit child trafficking.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT CRIMINALIZING NECROPHILIA OR CARNAL KNOWLEDGE WITH THE DEAD AND IMPOSING APPROPRIATE PENALTIES THEREFOR, INCORPORATING FOR THIS PURPOSE ARTICLE 335-A INTO ACT NO. 3815, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE REVISED PENAL CODE
rows.abstract: Defines "necrophilia" as the act committed by a person who engages in sexual intercourse with a female coprse. Imposes the penalty of reclusion perpetua to death and a fine of P100,000.00 to P500,000.00 for his crime.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1998-07-29

rows.manual_status: Approved by the House and transmitted to the Senate on 2000-10-26
rows.author: C054
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2000-10-26, transmitted to on 2000-10-26 and received by the Senate on 2000
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING FURTHER THE SPECIAL PROGRAM FOR EMPLOYMENT OF STUDENTS UNDER REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7323 BY INCREASING THE INCOME REQUIREMENT FOR COVERAGE THEREIN, PROVIDING A NON-DIMINUTION AND AUTOMATIC INCREASE CLAUSES FOR ITS BUDGETARY ALLOCATIONAND PENALIZING THOSE WHO DISHONOR THE EDUCATION VOUCHERS, AMENDING FOR THESE PURPOSES REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7323 ENTITLED "AN ACT TO HELP POOR BUT DESERVING STUDENTS PURSUE THEIR EDUCATION BY ENCOURAGING THEIR EMPLOYMENT DURING SUMMER AND/OR CHRISTMAS VACATIONS, THROUGH INCENTIVES GRANTED TO EMPLOYERS, ALLOWING THEM TO PAY ONLY SIXTY PER CENTUM OF THEIR SALARIES OR WAGES AND THE FORTY PER CENTUM THROUGH EDUCATION VOUCHERS TO BE PAID BY THE GOVERNMENT PROHIBITING AND PENALIZING THE FILING OF FRAUDULENT OR FICTITIOUS CLAIMS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES"
rows.abstract: Increases the income requirement for coverage under the Special Program for Employment of Students (SPES); broadens the number of student-benefic iaries.
rows.status: Substituted by HB12235

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR UNEMPLOYMENT ASSISTANCE TO CERTAIN EMPLOYEES SEPARATED FROM EMPLOYMENT OR SERVICE, ESTABLISHING THE UNEMPLOYMENT ASSISTANCE FUND, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Unemployment Assistance Act of 1998". Grants monetary unemployment assistance to qualified employees and workers in the private  and public sectors who are separated from employment or service through no fault of their own.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING EMPLOYERS TO FURNISH EMPLOYEES COPIES OF THE EMPLOYMENT CONTRACTS AND TO MAKE A SWORN DECLARATION THEREFOR, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE ARTICLE 279 OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 442, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Requires employers to furnish the employees copies of the employment contracts in cases where employment agreements are reduced into writing and to make sworn declaration to this effect.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING A CHILDREN'S WELFARE FUND FOR THE PROTECTION AND REHABILITATION OF ABANDONED, ABUSED AND SEXUALLY EXPLOITED CHILDREN AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED 7610, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS 'THE SPECIAL PROTECTION OF CHILDREN AGAINST CHILD ABUSE, EXPLOITATION AND DISCRIMINATION ACT'
rows.abstract: Establishes a protection and rehabilitaiton fund for abandoned, abused and sexually exploited childred in the amount of one hundred million pesos (P100,000,000.0 0) to be managed by the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SOCIAL SERVICES since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING FURTHER VOLUNTARY ARBITRATION AS A PREFERENTIAL MODE OF SETTLING LABOR DISPUTE BY PROVIDING THAT DECISIONS OF VOLUNTARY ARBITRATORS SHALL BE REVIEWABLE ONLY BY THE SUPREME COURT, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE ARTICLE 262-A OF THE LABOR CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Reaffirms and underscores the constitutional provision on the promotion of the PREFERENTIAL USE OF VOLUNTARY MODES in settling disputes. (Sec. 3 (par. 3), Art. XIII).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.manual_status: Approved by the House and transmitted to the Senate on 2001-02-06
rows.author: C054
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2001-02-05, transmitted to on 2001-02-06 and received by the Senate on 2001
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING ALL FRANCHISE HOLDERS OR OPERATORS OF TELEVISION STATIONS, PRODUCERS OF TELEVISION PROGRAMS, HOME VIDEO PROGRAMS AND MOTION PICTURES TO HAVE THEIR PROGRAMS AND FILMS BROADCAST WITH CLOSED-CAPTION AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF
rows.abstract: Defines "CLOSED-CAPTION " as  the method of substitling TV programs and films to benefit hearing-impaire d and foreign language viewers.
rows.status: Substituted by HB12367

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT RATIONALIZING FURTHER THE WAGE FIXING MECHANISM BY RECONSTITUTING THE MEMBERSHIP IN THE REGIONAL TRIPARTITE WAGES AND PRODUCTIVITY BOARDS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLE 122 OF THE LABOR CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: INCLUDES the DOLE Regional Director as Chairman of the Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Board. Converts the NEDA and the DTI Regional Director as NONVOTING members.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING PRIVILEGED COMMUNICATION IN THE COMPULSORY AND VOLUNTARY ARBITRATION PROCEEDINGS FOR PURPOSES OF AMICABLE SETTLEMENT,Q AMENDING THEREBY ARTICLE 221 OF THE LABOR CODE
rows.abstract: States that all information declarations, disclosures, admissions, offers or counter offers made during mandatory conference and conciliations SHALL BE INADMISSIBLE in evidence against the party making the same.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING FURTHER THE RIGHT OF DAUGHTERS AGAINST INCESTUOUS RAPE BY PENALIZING MOTHERS WHO REFRAIN FROM PROCEEDING AGAINST THE FATHER-RAPISTS OR TOLERATE ITS COMMISSION
rows.abstract: Seeks to uphold the sanctity of the family and restore tranquility in the family home.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE MANDATORY DRUG-TESTING OF DRIVERS IN PUBLIC LAND TRANSPORT COMPANIES
rows.abstract: Substantiates the obligation of the State to protect the lives of its citizens. "Road safety continues to be a serious concern of the State."
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING MONETARY AWARDS IN FAVOR OF WORKERS FROM TAXES AND OTHER ASSESSMENTS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLE 279 OF THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Aims to remedy the present situation where the considerable delay in granting workers' monetary claims has invariably diminished the value of the awarded claim due the workers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT ENTITLING THE WORKER THE OPTION TO BE PAID SEPARATION PAY IN LIEU OF REINSTATEMENT IN ILLEGAL DISMISSAL CASES WHERE REINSTATEMENT IS ORDERED, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE ARTICLE 279 OF THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Grants dismissed employees  the ALTERNATIVE to choose during termination disputes.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE ISSUANCE OF EMPLOYMENT CERTIFICATION IN FAVOR OF RESIGNED OR TERMINATED EMPLOYEES AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREFOR, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Institutionaliz es the EMPLOYMENT CERTIFICATION and provides penal sanctions for its violation.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT DISAUTHORIZING THE PROVISION OF DIRECT GOVERNMENT GUARANTEE FOR THE FINANCING, CONSTRUCTION, OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE OF ANY INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECT UNDERTAKEN THROUGH BUILD-OPERATE-A ND-TRANSFER (BOT) SCHEME AND SIMILAR VARIATIONS UNDER REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6957, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Considers the present provision on direct government guarantee as "... not only ONEROUS... but may also condemn the government to receiving undertakings which are ill-conceived in the first instance."
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT DISAUTHORIZING THE DETAIL OF LABOR ARBITERS AS REVIEWERS OF COMMISSIONERS IN THE NATIONAL LABOR RELATIONS COMMISSION, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE ARTICLE 217 OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 442, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Recognizes the important role of the labor arbiters in the disposition of compulsory arbitration of cases, and therefore mandates  that labor arbiters SHALL NOT BE DESIGNATED AS REVIEWERS in the National Labor Relations Commission or to any other agency performing quasi-judicial functions.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE NAMING OF DESTRUCTIVE FORCES OF NATURE OR UNDERTAKINGS WITH DESTRUCTIVE POTENTIALS AFTER FEMININE NAMES
rows.abstract: Seeks to eliminate all forms of subtle discrimination against women, thereby enhancing their role and welfare, and creating an atmosphere of genuine equality between men and women.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY since 1998-07-29

rows.manual_status: Approved by the House and transmitted to the Senate on 2000-09-21
rows.author: C054
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2000-09-20 and transmitted to the Senate on 2000-09-21
rows.title_full: AN ACT RATIONALIZING FURTHER THE IMPOSITION OF PENAL SANCTIONS UNDER THE DANGEROUS DRUGS LAW OF 1972 BY PROVIDING PENALTIES SEPARATE AND DISTINCT FROM THOSE PROVIDED IN THE REVISED PENAL CODE (ACT NO. 3815, AS AMENDED) THEREBY PRECLUDING THE APPLICABILITY OF THE PROVISIONS OF THE LATTER IN DRUG OFFENSES, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE, REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6425, AS AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7659
rows.abstract: Seeks to REIMPOSE the DEATH PENALTY as mandatory or discretionary sentence in drug abuse cases  without being encumberred by the technical terms in the Revised Penal Code.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10665

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING FURTHER THE RIGHT OF ALL WORKERS TO UNIONIZE BY AUTHORIZING MEMBERS OF COOPERATIVES TO JOIN UNIONS, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE ARTICLE 212 (e) AND (f) OF THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Substantiates the constitutional mandate to guarantee the rights of ALL WORKERS TO SELF-ORGANIZATI ON.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING COURTS AND QUASI-JUDICIAL BODIES TO FURNISH WORKERS AN ADVISORY OF ENTITIES PROVIDING FREE LEGAL SERVICES IN CASES INVOLVING EMPLOYMENT RELATIONS
rows.abstract: Enhances workers' right to free access to courts, quasi-judicial bodies and adequate legal assistance.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.manual_status: Approved by the House and transmitted to the Senate on 2000-11-29
rows.author: C054
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2000-11-28, transmitted to on 2000-11-29 and received by the Senate on 2000
rows.title_full: AN ACT PENALIZING STEALING FROM, AND OTHER ACTS OF DESECRATION OF THE DEAD
rows.abstract: Promotes profound respect for the dead.
rows.status: Substituted by HB12335

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT ABOLISHING FIXED TERM EMPLOYMENT OR EMPLOYMENT WITH DEFINITE PERIOD IN CONTRACTS INVOLVING HOUSEHELPERS DELETING FOR THS PURPOSE ARTICLE 142 OF THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Ensures the security of tenure of househelpers, thereby removing the present status of domestic helpers as "second-class" workers based on the Labor Code provision , Art. 142.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT RESTORING THE AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY OF LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT TO APPROVE THE PROMULGATION OF RULES BY THE NATIONAL LABOR RELATIONS COMMISSION, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE ARTICLE 218 (a) OF THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: RESTORES the authority of the DOLE Secretary to APPROVE the Rules promulgated by the NLRC in line with the Secretary's general rule-making authority.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT RESTORING THE AUTHORITY OF THE BUREAU OF LABOR RELATIONS OVER APPEALS IN CERTIFICATION ELECTION CASES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLE 259 OF THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Will relieve the DOLE Secretary of the authority over appeals from certification election orders, a task which could be very well handled by the Bureau of Labor Relations.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING FURTHER THE LAW PROVIDING FOR STRONGER DETERRENCE AND SPECIAL PROTECTION AGAINST CHILD ABUSE, EXPLOITATION AND DISCRIMINATION BY PENALIZING PEDOPHILIA OR SEXUAL INTERCOURSE OR OTHER SEXUAL ABUSE AND CHILD TRAFFICKING COMMITTED BY CERTAIN PERSONS OVERSEAS INCORPORATING FOR THIS PURPOSE ARTICLE X-A INTO REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7610, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Seeks to CRIMINALIZE pedophilia, sexual intercourse or other sexual abuse and child trafficking COMMITTED OVERSEAS or outside Philippine territories if committed by persons/entites with reasonable connection with the Philippines.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A LEGAL RESEARCH UNIT IN EACH OF THE FIVE (5) DIVISIONS OF THE NATIONAL LABOR RELATIONS COMMISSION. AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE ARTICLE 213 OF THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: States that the proposed Legal Research Unit shall be composed of COMMISSION ATTORNEYS well-versed in labor laws and jurisprudence , and shall handle the NLRC's legal research requirements.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

principal_referral.committee: MICRO, SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISE DEVELOPMENT

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT ENHANCING FURTHER WORKERS' WELFARE BY PROHIBITING AND CRIMINALIZING 'BOUNDARY SYSTEM' AND SIMILAR SCHEMES IN TAXI AND OTHER PUBLIC TRANSPORT COMPANIES
rows.abstract: Seeks to put an end to the vicious boundary system which marginalizes drivers and deprives them of their rights to self organize and to security of tenure.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPOSING STIFFER PENALTIES FOR CERTAIN INSTANCES OF QUALIFIED THEFT THEREBY AMENDING ARTICLE 310, CHAPTER THREEE OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 3815, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE REVISED PENAL CODE
rows.abstract: Refers to theft committed during calamities, emergency, accidents and if the property is taken  from a crime victim.
rows.status: Bill reported out 2000-06-21 (#01085);Submitted by REVISION OF LAWS

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING FURTHER VOLUNTARY ARBITRATION AS A MODE OF LABOR DISPUTE SETTLEMENT BY AUTHORIZING THE VOLUNTARY ARBITRATOR OR PANEL OF VOLUNTARY ARBITRATORS TO ISSUE SUBPOENAS, IMPOSE FINES AND CITE PERSONS IN CONTEMPT, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLE 262-A OF THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Paves the way for the sustained development of voluntary arbitration as an effective mode of labor dispute settlement.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECRIMINALIZING CERTAIN ACTS OF VAGRANCY, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE ARTICLE 202 NO. 3815, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'REVISED PENAL CODE'
rows.abstract: Proposes to establish a new concept of VAGRANCY by defining "vagrants" as (1) a person who DELIBERATELY neglects to apply himself to some lawful calling; and (2) prostitutes.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE PAYMENT OF SEPARATION PAY OF AT LEAST THREE (3) MONTHS FOR EVERY YEAR OF SERVICE IN LIEU OF REINSTATEMENT IN CASES OF STRAINED RELATIONS BETWEEN THE EMPLOYER AND EMPLOYEE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLE 279 OF THE LABOR CODE
rows.abstract: Protects the workers' constitutional provision seeking to guarantee the "rights of all workes to self-organizati on, and peaceful concerted activities, including the right to strike..."
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING FURTHER WORKERS' RIGHT TO UNIONIZE BY DISALLOWING THE FORMATION OF LABOR-MANAGEMEN T COUNCILS OR SIMILAR BODIES IN ORGANIZED COMPANIES, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE ARTICLE 277 (H) OF THE LABOR CODE
rows.abstract: Substantiates the constitutional provision seeking to guarantee the "rights of all workers to self-organizati on, collective bargaining and negotiations, and peaceful concerted activities, including the right to strike..."
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING FURTHER THE WORKERS' RIGHT TO SELF-ORGANIZATI ON BY RATIONALIZING THE STATUTORY REQUIREMENTS FOR UNION REGISTRATION, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE ARTICLE 234 OF THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: States that the FAILURE to comply with any of the requirements for union registration SHALL NOT be a ground for the dismissal of the application.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING CERTAIN BUILDINGS, INSTITUTIONS, ESTABLISHMENTS AND PUBLIC UTILITIES TO RESERVE SUFFICIENT AND SUITABLE PARKING OR SEATING SPACES FOR THE USE OF EXPECTANT MOTHERS
rows.abstract: Provides measures to enhance the welfare and well-being of expectant mothers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WOMEN since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING FURTHER THE RIGHTS OF THE PARTIES UNDER VOLUNTARY ARBITRATION, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE ARTICLE 262-A OF THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Restates that the decision/award of the voluntary arbitration is FINAL and EXECUTORY; therefore NO motion for consideration may be entertained.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29

rows.author: C054
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING SEPARATION PAY OF AT LEAST ONE (1) MONTH PAY FOR EVERY YEAR OF SERVICE TO A RESIGNING EMPLOYEE WHO HAS RENDERED AT LEAST TEN (10) YEARS OF SERVICE WITH HIS EMPLOYER, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE ARTICLE 285 OF THE LABOR CODE, EMPLOYER AND EMPLOYEE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLE 279 OF THE LABOR CODE
rows.abstract: Considers this pay a LONGEVITY COMPENSATION and award for the loyalty of the employee.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-29
